t: Dulux Trade Supermatt is a water-based matt emulsion paint designed for interior walls and ceilings. This professional-grade white matt paint provides exceptional opacity and a smooth finish, making it ideal for decorators working on new plaster, commercial projects, and residential renovations. With a coverage rate of 18m²/Ltr, trade professionals can complete jobs efficiently. The quick-drying formula is touch-dry and ready for a second coat in just 2 to 4 hours, ensuring rapid project turnaround times. This low-odour paint features a trace VOC level, making it suitable for occupied indoor spaces.
